title: CoordinateGermCohomologyClasses
statement: Use the finite datum, coordinate classes and uniquely normalized support adjunction [def-pur-coordinate-germ-concentration-data], the existing support functors [def-pur-etale-coordinate-support], and normalized supported pullback [def-pur-supported-class-operations] and comparison [def-pur-supported-hom-site-comparison]. For a closed immersion i:C→X, a supported arrow α:i_*A_C→A_X(r)[q] defines its actual supported cohomology class by bounded-below derived adjunction, H^0, evaluation at 1, and the canonical shift comparison to H^q RΓ_C. Define global supported cohomology, the identity germ, the projection A^b_B→A^b_k, and the inverse-image zero section by the fibre product, with its canonical chosen Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Pull back the ordered twisted coordinate class through this square. For an etale e:Y→X and inverse-image closed support j:D→Y, define supported-stalk restriction by the recorded normalized derived restriction followed by the specified signed coefficient comparison. The sheaf support exchange e^*Q_C→Q_De^* is the unique natural transformation whose composite with the target support inclusion is e^* of the source inclusion; equivalently it is the literal identity on complement kernels on every etale test object. Define its derived exchange using the bounded-below right-derived base-change transformation.
